posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Thanks to Sentinels Live I discovered that in Bottom of the Ninth there is in fact one honest to god pic of Argent Adept smiling and having fun. Apparently even super serious bards can't resist a good game of baseball.

Also as much as I was laughing like mad at the alliterative Virtuoso names, I feel like I should note that usually "chanteuse" refers to a female singer. >_>

I'm really curious about his side-project with Idealist. Between Visionary, Unity, and now Idealist, Anthony seems to be developing a Wolverine-like trend of mentoring teenage girls.

The whole one-with-the-Void-after-you-die thing with the Virtuosos continues to kinda creep me out, including the fact that Anthony almost accidentally exiled himself from existence, basically. I wonder if Foote has gotten to listen and tweak their Void theories any.

I see that Tactics continues to be the timeline of most people making really bad choices.  “Yeah you’re busy overloading yourself with power and there’s this whole power binding ritual that’s just been kinda sitting off in the corner here, there’s no way any of this could possibly go wrong.” At least he gets an awesome scarf out of it all?

And Anthony's fate in the RPG timeline is… weirdly adorable? Like kinda bizarrely sweet? I'm not the only one who reads it that way, am I?

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Powerhound_2000:

I thought what defined a Relic in the game was interesting as it had bothered me that Instruments weren't Relics but were an intricate part of his character.   The idea that a Relic has power to it that whomever uses it will be granted that power whereas his Instruments while powerful do not impart powers upon just anyone.  Makes me wonder about the items in Apostate's deck and if there were other wielders of it along with what granted them power since he is directly tied to them.  Also, what would happen if someone took Fanatic's Aegis and Sword along with how powerful Citizen Truth's shield is to stop a Relic.  

I don't think they've been consistent about that.  We know that Absolution, for instance, only has power because Fanatic believes it should.  I don't think it would work for anything else.  But they also suggested that the "Relic" keyword is more about how resistant to destruction the item in question is, and we know the instruments get destroyed all the time.
